class.name: DynamicResolutionPanicPolicy
class.brief_description: Bounded GPU over-budget panic policy for dynamic 3D resolution.
class.description: Calculates a fast emergency decrease in the viewport's internal 3D scale when consecutive GPU frames strongly exceed their frame-time budget. Inspired by Unreal Engine's dynamic resolution panic behavior. Does not read frame timers or modify a viewport: the caller owns the GPU data, warmup, cooldown, and actual scaler. CPU-bound slowdowns and missing GPU timing never trigger a panic.

method.name: calculate_scale
method.description: Returns the next 3D scale. At least [param required_frames] consecutive GPU-over-budget frames and [param gpu_ms] at least the greater of 38 ms or 1.75 times [param target_ms] trigger the reduction. Pixel cost is approximated as quadratic in linear resolution, capped to a 0.12 scale reduction per request, quantized to 1% and never lowered beyond [param floor_scale]. Otherwise returns the unchanged [param current_scale]. Requires finite current/floor scales between 0.5 and 1, floor not above current, GPU time in 0..80 ms, target in 5..40 ms, valid frame count and required count 1..10. Invalid data returns -1 and must not be applied.
